channelMissingDetail: This channel is no longer in the playlist. It may have been renamed or removed.
roomMissingDetail: The room number may no longer be valid, or the streamer moved to another room.
needsLoginDetail: Sign in to the platform to watch this. You can sign in under Me → Platform accounts.
rateLimitedDetail: The platform is limiting requests. Try again in a moment.
riskControlDetail: The platform refused the request for now. Try again later or on another network.
regionBlockedDetail: The platform restricts access from this region. You can set a proxy for this platform in Settings.
noStreamDetail: The platform has no playable line right now. Try again later.
unsupportedLinkDetail: Room links from Douyu, Huya, Bilibili, Douyin and Kuaishou are supported.
apiChangedDetail: Update the app to keep using this platform.
networkDetail: Check your network or proxy settings and try again.
platformUnsupportedDetail: {name} has been retired or is not supported by this version. Its follows and watch history are kept.
genericDetail: The cause is not one we recognise. Try again; if it keeps happening, export a diagnostics bundle from Diagnostics and logs and attach it to a bug report.
